title: Instructional Entry
description: A single instructional entry — a recipe, principle, technique, or definition — together with its location within the cookbook.

EntryBase.title: Base Entry Fields
EntryBase.description: Fields shared by all entry types.

_id.description: The entry's unique numeric identifier, stored as a string (e.g., '1', '42').

title.description: The display title of the entry.

introduction.description: Introductory paragraphs for the entry, each either a plain string or a titled content block.

notes.description: Supplementary notes appended after the main content, each either a plain string or a titled content block.

chapter_id.description: The machine-readable identifier of the chapter this entry belongs to (e.g., 'chapter-i').

section_id.description: The machine-readable identifier of the section this entry belongs to (e.g., 'chapter-i/section-1').

section_path.description: The ordered list of section titles forming the breadcrumb path to this entry.

RecipeEntry.title: Recipe Entry
RecipeEntry.description: Additional fields required when the entry type is 'recipe'.

yield.description: The expected output quantity or serving size (e.g., 'Four Quarts (3.79 L)').

ingredients.description: The list of ingredients. Most are plain strings, but grouped recipes may use titled content blocks to separate ingredient sets by sub-recipe.

instructions.description: The ordered preparation steps, each either a plain string or a titled content block.

PrincipleEntry.title: Principle Entry
PrincipleEntry.description: Constrains the type discriminator for principle entries.

TechniqueEntry.title: Technique Entry
TechniqueEntry.description: Constrains the type discriminator for technique entries.

DefinitionEntry.title: Definition Entry
DefinitionEntry.description: Constrains the type discriminator for definition entries.
